lines.text: When an AI agent quotes a search result, how do you know the number is real?
serp-receipts is an open-source MCP server for SerpApi. Every result comes with a receipt, and any agent can check it.
lines.say: Serp receipts is an open-source M C P server for Serp A P I. Every result comes with a receipt, and any agent can check it.

lines.text: An MCP client connects and sees four tools: search, get receipt, verify receipt, and credits.
lines.say: An M C P client connects, and sees four tools: search, get receipt, verify receipt, and credits.

lines.text: Agent A runs a scholar search on Indian summer monsoon rainfall prediction. It is a replay of a real SerpApi search, so it costs no credits.
lines.say: Agent A runs a scholar search on Indian summer monsoon rainfall prediction. It is a replay of a real Serp A P I search, so it costs no credits.

lines.text: Every result has a receipt ID. The top paper is cited by 251.
lines.say: Every result has a receipt I D. The top paper is cited by two hundred and fifty one.

lines.text: Its receipt pins the engine, the parameters without the API key, SerpApi's search ID and time, a JSON pointer, and a hash of the result.
lines.say: Its receipt pins the engine, the parameters without the A P I key, Serp A P I's search I D and time, a Jason pointer, and a hash of the result.

lines.text: Verifier B has no SerpApi key at all. It re-fetches the original search from SerpApi's archive, live, and checks the claim.
lines.say: Verifier B has no Serp A P I key at all. It re-fetches the original search from Serp A P I's archive, live, and checks the claim.

lines.text: Receipt intact, same search, hash matches, and the count really is 251. Verified.
lines.say: Receipt intact, same search, hash matches, and the count really is two hundred and fifty one. Verified.

lines.text: Now someone edits the receipt to say 2510. Verification fails, and shows what the archive really says.
lines.say: Now someone edits the receipt to say two thousand five hundred and ten. Verification fails, and shows what the archive really says.

lines.text: Live searches go through a hard credit cap, a ledger and a cache. In our tests, archive checks used no credits.
lines.say: Live searches go through a hard credit cap, a ledger, and a cache. In our tests, archive checks used no credits.

lines.text: Install it from GitHub, and give your agents receipts. Built by Harsha Shinde.
